name: autovacuum_work_mem
description: Sets the maximum memory available to each autovacuum worker process for operations like vacuuming and analyzing tables.
symptoms: Long-running autovacuum tasks blocking table bloat
High CPU or I/O wait during maintenance windows
tuning_tips: Set it higher than default (-1) to speed up autovacuum on large tables, but avoid setting it too high to prevent memory contention with other workers or backend processes. Monitor autovacuum duration and memory pressure before increasing.
